parties: Wipro Limited (acquirer); Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited (target)
headline: Wipro completes acquisition of additional 20% stake in Aggne Global IT Services
sum: Wipro Limited has completed acquisition of an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited, effective 18 June 2026 and intimated to the exchange on 19 June 2026.
detail: Wipro informed the National Stock Exchange on 18 June 2026 of its intention to acquire an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited, a private company. The transaction was completed on the same date (18 June 2026) and formal intimation of completion was received by Wipro on 19 June 2026. The acquisition was announced with an expected completion timeline by 30 June 2026 but was accelerated and concluded by 18 June itself. No acquisition value, source of funds, or strategic rationale have been disclosed in the NSE intimation filing.
